raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Fix explicit draft `moe_backend` overrides when the target uses a self-dispatching FlashInfer MoE backend. Resolve the draft's communication setting together with its backend, before validating the derived config.

## Claims

- A regular draft backend no longer inherits the target's inferred `all2all_backend='passthrough'`, which previously prevented MTP model loading.
- The target configuration and unrelated explicitly selected communication backends remain unchanged.

## Validation

GB200 validation of the retained tests: 4 cases passed, including the public LLM/MTP regression. All targeted pre-commit checks pass.

Base: `b82393b77315692f390880d2e931fdc1fbd13928`.

```bash
PYTHONPATH=$PWD /home/woosuk/workspace/vllm/.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/v1/spec_decode/test_draft_moe_backend_override.py -v
```

The public LLM regression reproduces the base validation failure:

```
all2all_backend='passthrough' is only valid with a moe_backend that dispatches and combines itself [...], got moe_backend='flashinfer_trtllm'.
```

Final full test file: **8 passed** in 47.25 s on one GB200. On the base commit, the new constructor and public LLM regressions fail with the validation error above; the three neighboring constructor cases pass (2 failed, 3 passed, 3 deselected in 10.25 s). All pre-commit hooks pass, including mypy.

A public `LLM` regression uses a tiny local MiMo model, MTP with two draft tokens, target `flashinfer_moe_ep_cutedsl` configuration and draft `flashinfer_trtllm`. On one GB200 GPU it loads and generates four valid tokens after the fix. This is a config/startup regression: the tiny model is dense and uses dummy weights, so it makes no claim about MegaMoE kernels, multi-GPU communication, or model quality. The user-visible failure occurs during draft config validation, before such kernels can run.

## Details

`KernelConfig` resolves the target's default all-to-all setting to internal `passthrough` when its MoE backend owns dispatch/combine. Draft overrides previously replaced only the kernel sub-config, validating it while the inherited parallel sub-config still contained `passthrough`. A regular draft backend rejects that invalid combination.

When an explicit override switches away from a self-dispatching backend, rebuild the draft parallel config with the regular default `allgather_reducescatter`, then apply all sub-config replacements atomically. Unset overrides, compatible self-dispatching drafts, and existing explicit communication settings keep their prior behavior. No serving model-runner or communication-kernel code changes.

Duplicate checks searched open PRs for `"apply_draft_overrides"`, `"draft" "all2all_backend"`, and `"draft" "passthrough"`. [#58332](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/58332) changes config hashing, [#54109](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/54109) adds a DeepEP activation format, and [#43319](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/43319) handles DeepSeek draft checkpoint quantization. None resolves inherited internal communication during draft overrides. The finding came from local GLM PCP/MTP experiments; it has no linked GitHub issue. This change does not expand PCP/speculation support or overlap with PCP capture fixes.

AI assistance (OpenAI Codex) was used to implement, test, and prepare this change. The human submitter confirmed review of every changed line and execution of the relevant tests before submission.

---

- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.
- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.

- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.

@@ -9,6 +9,16 @@ MTP is useful when:
 - Your model natively supports MTP.
 - You want model-based speculative decoding with minimal extra configuration.
 
+## Draft MoE backend
+
+An unquantized MTP head may need a different MoE backend from its quantized
+target. Set `moe_backend` inside `--speculative-config`, for example
+`'{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":2,"moe_backend":"flashinfer_trtllm"}'`.
+When the target uses a self-dispatching FlashInfer MoE backend, a regular draft
+backend uses the default all-gather/reduce-scatter communication instead of
+inheriting the target's internal `passthrough` setting. The target retains its
+own backend and communication configuration.
+
 ## Gemma 4 Assistant Models
 
 Gemma 4 assistant checkpoints use vLLM's Gemma 4 MTP path. They are not generic

 from unittest.mock import patch
 
 import pytest
+from transformers import Qwen2Config
 
+from vllm import SamplingParams
 from vllm.config import LoadConfig, SpeculativeConfig
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
 from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.spec_decode.eagle.utils import load_eagle_model
 
 
@@ -95,3 +98,44 @@ def test_override_does_not_mutate_the_target_config():
     cfg = _config("flashinfer_b12x", "flashinfer_cutlass")
     _capture_draft_config(cfg)
     assert cfg.kernel_config.moe_backend == "flashinfer_b12x"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(not current_platform.is_cuda(), reason="CUDA backend override")
+def test_mtp_with_self_dispatching_target_backend(vllm_runner, tmp_path):
+    """An explicit regular draft backend can load and generate with MTP."""
+    Qwen2Config(
+        architectures=["MiMoForCausalLM"],
+        hidden_size=128,
+        intermediate_size=256,
+        num_hidden_layers=2,
+        num_attention_heads=2,
+        num_key_value_heads=2,
+        num_nextn_predict_layers=1,
+        vocab_size=1024,
+    ).save_pretrained(tmp_path)
+    with vllm_runner(
+        str(tmp_path),
+        load_format="dummy",
+        skip_tokenizer_init=True,
+        max_model_len=256,
+        max_num_batched_tokens=256,
+        max_num_seqs=2,
+        gpu_memory_utilization=0.2,
+        enforce_eager=True,
+        kernel_config={
+            "moe_backend": "flashinfer_moe_ep_cutedsl",
+            "enable_jit_warmup": False,
+        },
+        speculative_config={
+            "method": "mtp",
+            "num_speculative_tokens": 2,
+            "moe_backend": "flashinfer_trtllm",
+        },
+    ) as runner:
+        (output,) = runner.llm.generate(
+            [{"prompt_token_ids": [1, 2, 3]}],
+            SamplingParams(temperature=0, max_tokens=4, ignore_eos=True),
+        )
+        tokens = output.outputs[0].token_ids
+        assert len(tokens) == 4
+        assert all(0 <= token < 1024 for token in tokens)

@@ -10,7 +10,11 @@
 
 from vllm.config import LoadConfig
 from vllm.config.cache import CacheDType
-from vllm.config.kernel import MoEBackend
+from vllm.config.kernel import (
+    FLASHINFER_MOE_EP_BACKENDS,
+    PASSTHROUGH_ALL2ALL_BACKEND,
+    MoEBackend,
+)
 from vllm.config.model import HfOverrides, ModelConfig
 from vllm.config.parallel import ParallelConfig
 from vllm.config.utils import config, replace
@@ -1882,11 +1886,25 @@ def apply_draft_overrides(self, vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> VllmConfig:
         Only non-None fields override, so an unset field keeps whatever the
         target resolved.
         """
+        overrides: dict[str, Any] = {}
+        if (
+            self.moe_backend is not None
+            and self.moe_backend not in FLASHINFER_MOE_EP_BACKENDS
+            and vllm_config.kernel_config.moe_backend in FLASHINFER_MOE_EP_BACKENDS
+            and vllm_config.parallel_config.all2all_backend
+            == PASSTHROUGH_ALL2ALL_BACKEND
+        ):
+            # Passthrough was inferred for the target's self-dispatching backend.
+            overrides["parallel_config"] = replace(
+                vllm_config.parallel_config,
+                all2all_backend="allgather_reducescatter",
+            )
         for src, config_name, dst in _DRAFT_VLLM_CONFIG_OVERRIDES:
             if (value := getattr(self, src)) is not None:
-                sub_config = replace(getattr(vllm_config, config_name), **{dst: value})
-                vllm_config = replace(vllm_config, **{config_name: sub_config})
-        return vllm_config
+                overrides[config_name] = replace(
+                    getattr(vllm_config, config_name), **{dst: value}
+                )
+        return replace(vllm_config, **overrides) if overrides else vllm_config
